{"task": {"role": "You read the description of an outfit and list its items as data.", "rules": ["One object per item — garment, shoes, bag, accessory, jewelry — in the order of the description, with its words and hex.", "One item carries one thing — of two alternatives list the first; a note in brackets is not an item.", "Slot "accessory" is for an item no other slot fits.", ""is_outfit" says whether the description is an outfit: no — when in place of items it has a refusal, a question or a note."], "limits": ["Rely only on the input: do not invent what it does not contain.", "The answer is one JSON object following "answer_schema", without explanations and without ```."], "language": "English", "answer": "ITEM_LIST", "answer_schema": {"is_outfit": "yes|no", "items": [{"name": "<what the item is>", "details": "<its cut, length and fabric>", "slot": "top|bottom|dress|set|outerwear|shoes|bag|scarf|headwear|belt|tights|socks|jewelry|earrings|collar_necklace|necklace|brooch|bracelet|ring|glasses|gloves|watch|swimwear|underwear|accessory", "color_hex": "<#rrggbb or null>", "worn": "<true, or false when the description says the outfit goes without it>"}]}, "input": [""description" — the outfit description"]}, "description": "OUTFIT_TEXT
Relaxed-fit silk blouse, loose cut, mid-length, soft cream, 19% mulberry silk
Tailored wool-blend trousers, straight-leg cut, full length, charcoal heather, 50% virgin wool with 27% mohair
Chunky knit cardigan, relaxed boxy cut, hip length, forest green, 65% acrylic and 35% wool
Leather ankle boots, pointed toe, mid-calf height, dark brown, smooth full-grain leather
This ensemble balances the request for a calm mood with the upscale restaurant setting through sophisticated textures like silk and fine wool. The neutral cream base creates a serene backdrop that allows the deep forest green of the cardigan to add a touch of autumnal elegance without appearing loud. By avoiding an outer layer due to the warm evening temperature, the look remains breathable while maintaining a polished yet understated refinement suitable for a quiet dinner."}
